FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE 
Press Release No. 122 /2026 
TRAI Launches Digital Connectivity Rating Platform 
New Delhi, September 25, 2026: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) today 
launched the Digital Connectivity Rating (DCR) Platform, an integrated digital platform 
designed to provide visibility of rating of properties to the consumers and facilitate the end-
to-end process for rating the digital connectivity of properties along with a mobile app for 
testing digital connectivity. 
The DCR Platform facilitates implementation of the framework prescribed under the Telecom 
Regulatory Authority of India (Rating of Properties for Digital Connectivity) Regulations, 2024, 
as amended by the Rating of Properties for Digital Connectivity (Amendment) Regulation, 
2026, notified on 13 May 2026 and rating process specified in Rating Manual 2026, issued by 
TRAI on 9 June 2026. 
The platform provides a public interface for consumers to view the properties rated for digital 
connectivity. It brings Property Managers (PMs) registered Digital Connectivity Rating Agency 
(DCRA) and consumer onto a common digital interface. Property Managers can register their 
properties in category of Public, Government, Commercial, Private etc., submit rating 
applications, upload the prescribed information and documents, select a registered DCRA and 
track the status of their application through the platform. The platform supports the 
prescribed assessment workflow for both constructed and under-construction properties. 
Registered DCRAs can access assigned applications, undertake assessments, record 
observations and test results, manage supporting documentation and complete the rating 
process in accordance with the prescribed framework. The platform enables the digital 
workflow relating to assessment, report generation, certification and publication of ratings. 
Consumers and other stakeholders will be able to search rated properties, view published 
ratings, verify the corresponding certificates and compare the properties of interest. 
Field assessments will be facilitated through a dedicated DCRA mobile app. The app will 
enable authorised DCRA to undertake in-building digital connectivity measurements in 
accordance with the prescribed testing methodology. Property information received through 
the web portal and the assessment data captured through the mobile application will be 
synchronised in the platform. The platform integrates eSign for the digital signing and 
verification of documents and certificates. It also supports online payment of applicable rating 
fees, email and SMS alerts, and secure storage of property records, test results, certificates 
and audit logs. 
For Consumers, the platform offers a public rating search page. Consumers can search for a 
rated property by property name, certificate ID or location. They can view the property's 
digitally signed rating certificate and verify its authenticity through the QR code provided on 
the certificate. This will make digital connectivity a visible and verifiable attribute of a rated 
property and empowers consumers with connectivity information. Based on this information 
consumer can make an informed choice while selecting the desired property prior to making 
the final purchase or lease decision. 
Speaking on the occasion, Shri Anil Kumar Lahoti, Chairman, TRAI, said, "The Digital 
Connectivity Rating Platform establishes a transparent and standardised framework for 
assessing the digital connectivity readiness of properties. By making ratings publicly 
searchable and verify the certificates, the platform will empower consumers with 
credible and comparable information. It will help them make more informed choices 
about homes and offices with strong and reliable connectivity, supporting smoother 
calls, downloads and access to online services. It will also enable consumers to 
recognise the value of digital connectivity infrastructure built into a property, while 
encouraging Property Managers to plan such infrastructure at the appropriate stage of 
property development." 
About the Digital Connectivity Rating (DCR) Framework 
The DCR framework provides a standardised method for evaluating digital connectivity within 
properties. The assessment considers prescribed parameters relating to fibre readiness, 
mobile network availability, in-building solutions and Wi-Fi infrastructure, with applicable 
benchmarks for different categories of properties. The framework seeks to encourage the 
consideration of Digital Connectivity Infrastructure at appropriate stages of property 
development and facilitate the assessment of infrastructure and connectivity performance in 
existing properties. The Digital Connectivity Rating (DCR) Platform can be accessed at: 
https://dcrp.trai.gov.in 
For additional queries, please contact: Ms. Archna Ahlawat, Advisor (IT) at 
advisorit@trai.gov.in 
\P 
(Harer Kumar) 
Secretary, TRAI 
About TRAI 
The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) is an independent statutory body established 
under the TRAI Act, 1997. TRAI regulates the telecommunications, broadcasting and cable 
television sectors to promote transparent regulation, fair competition, consumer protection 
and the orderly growth of the telecom ecosystem.
